title: I am making a zombie horde shooter game using claude
author: john1587
selftext:
The Mansion is a first-person zombie horde shooter made with Claude in a couple of days, I just made this level but planning to expand to different locations and add more weapons.

* Board up and seal every window with metal plates made from scrap
* Pick an upgrade card after each horde: Desert Eagle, shotgun, AK-47, perks and more
* Molotovs, movable propane tanks, wine barrels that make zombies slip, and leaping zombies that pin you down
* Plays in the browser, no download



Play it here in your browser: [https://playgama.ai/play/ntamyx2qinozzx](https://playgama.ai/play/ntamyx2qinozzx)

Happy to answer questions about the workflow, and feedback is welcome!
